column1: # Shop stock. rank and slice "-" take the item's own; qty is how many per restock ("-" unlimited); restock is
# daily, 3d, weekly or once (a one-off per save). price "-" is the item's price times the shop's markup.
# pool: core rows are always on the shelf; rot rows fill the shop's weekly rotating slots (Classic takes them in
# order, a week at a time; Varied rolls them from the shops stream, keyed by shop id and week).
